name.fr-FR: Correspondance sur l’affaire du quiétisme II (1697-1699)
name.en-US: Correspondence on the Quietism Affair II (1697-1699)
name.pt-BR: Correspondência sobre o caso do quietismo II (1697-1699)

author.fr-FR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.en-US: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon
author.pt-BR: François de Salignac de La Mothe-Fénelon

description.fr-FR: Deuxième partie de la sixième section : la correspondance romaine et parisienne de Fénelon pendant le procès de son livre à Rome (tome 9 de l’édition). Les lettres adressées à Fénelon sont imprimées avec les siennes là où l’édition les place.
description.en-US: Second part of the sixth section: Fénelon’s Roman and Parisian correspondence during the trial of his book in Rome (volume 9 of the edition). Letters written to Fénelon are printed with his own where the edition places them.
description.pt-BR: Segunda parte da sexta seção: a correspondência romana e parisiense de Fénelon durante o processo de seu livro em Roma (tomo 9 da edição). As cartas escritas a Fénelon são impressas com as dele onde a edição as coloca.

fr-FR.editor: J.-E.-A. Gosselin (éd. Saint-Sulpice), Paris: Leroux et Jouby / Gaume

sources.edition: Œuvres complètes de Fénelon, Paris, Leroux et Jouby, 1851 (éd. Gosselin, Saint-Sulpice), tome 9, tome 9, section VI (suite); archive.org OCR (ABBYY).
sources.description: Machine-cleaned OCR: running heads, page numbers and hyphenation removed, paragraphs rejoined, obvious character errors corrected by a vote against the corpus vocabulary; period spelling kept. Residual OCR errors remain (see PROBLEMS.md).
sources.tierEvidence: Fénelon died in 1715; the 1851 edition is public domain.
